composition_variation: Create an original premium 2D anime wallpaper of exactly one woman, visibly 26 years old, with pearl-pink hair in an asymmetrical jaw-length bob with a longer curved front lock. She has mature, self-assured elegance and realistic adult proportions. Her face has warm brown eyes, delicately defined brows, subtle rosy cheeks, and a calm curious smile. Choose an opaque seafoam short-sleeved shirt with a neat collar and ivory loose trousers, plus small pearl earrings. She stands at a narrow botanical display table, holding a small magnifying glass close to a leaf while the other hand steadies the pot. A few fictional luminous seedpods glow softly among ordinary ferns, giving a tasteful fantasy touch. Keep the glass reflection simple and the hands anatomically clear. Indigo glasshouse shadows and warm pink accent light bring depth without cluttering the composition. Frame at eye level for a very tall phone crop. Keep her face, body, and hands inside the central narrow column, in the middle and lower image; leave the upper 25% calm and mostly empty for the clock. Natural nonsexual posture, opaque summer clothing, graceful anatomy, small readable hands close to her body. Refined linework, layered cel shading, painterly light, no text, logos, other people, or copied characters.
